items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 26 September 2026 6:48am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry with sunny spells.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15-20, then increasing S or SW 20-25 in the evening.


##Visibility##

Good. Isolated hill fog patches.


##Comments##

Strong winds later.


##Tomorrow##

Sunday will start cloudy with a band of rain arriving by mid-morning. This will turn heavy at times before clearing during the late afternoon, leaving late sunshine and clear spells.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-20, risk of 25.


##Wind Speed##

24


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

S or SE 20-25, increasing 25-30 (with gusts of 40-45) for a time in the afternoon, and then veering W by late afternoon. Then gradually decreasing 10-15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog until later.


##Comments##

Yellow coastal overtopping warning from 1100 to 1400. Strong winds. Some uncertainty remains in rainfall timing and amounts.


##Monday, 28 September 2026##

Dry with sunny spells.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

14


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

W or SW 10-15, gradually backing SE, then becoming 15-20 early in the night, and gradually increasing 25-30 by the end of the night.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing. Risk of coastal overtopping around time of high tide overnight (~1:30am Tue).


##Tuesday, 29 September 2026##

Cloudy, with only some patchy light rain for much of the day. However, a more persistent band of rain will arrive through the evening and overnight. This will turn heavy for a time, before clearing later in the night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

8-15, risk of 20.


##Wind Speed##

27


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

SE 25-30 (with gusts of 35-40), decreasing S 20-25 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good at first, becoming moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Deep/mature low likely to the W of the British Isles, bringing strong winds. Risk of stronger winds than stated. Risk of coastal overtopping around times of high tide (~1:35pm & ~2:00am Wednesday).


##Wednesday, 30 September 2026##

Sunny intervals and showers.


##Temperature##

1-4


##Wind Speed##

S

S 5 or 6, veering SW 4 or 5 later.

##Comments##

Nil.
